headline: DoorDash Launches Drone Delivery Program as Nearly 70% of Americans Say They Are Worried About Drone Safety
summary: DoorDash just secured federal clearance to fly its own delivery drones commercially, but a persistent trust gap with the American public may prove harder to clear than any regulatory hurdle.
